builds.name: Reference: Long-range finish
builds.goal: Reference for Senna: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A ranged support-carry hybrid who builds Mist through nearby deaths and repeated champion interactions, mixing attacks with piercing healing. Fix Mist stacks and role income, then compare Q healing/attacks with utility. Attack-speed scaling and earned range differ from ordinary marksmen; support routes retain the quest slot. Crit and a Rapid Firecannon attack window test safer pick damage.
builds.summary: Crit and a Rapid Firecannon attack window test safer pick damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Senna: Fix Mist stacks and role income, then compare Q healing/attacks with utility. Attack-speed scaling and earned range differ from ordinary marksmen; support routes retain the quest slot.

Start with the early core (Collector, then Infinity Edge) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit and a Rapid Firecannon attack window test safer pick damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: From the twin barrels of her Relic Cannon, Senna fires a unified beam of light and shadow through a target, healing allies and damaging enemies. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: RFC does not extend every ability; its charged attack must actually be consumed.

The route fails Senna's stated kit question: Fix Mist stacks and role income, then compare Q healing/attacks with utility. Attack-speed scaling and earned range differ from ordinary marksmen; support routes retain the quest slot.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: RFC does not extend every ability; its charged attack must actually be consumed.
Full cost 16,950 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Collector, then Infinity Edge. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rapid Firecannon, Lord Dominik's Regards, Bloodthirster are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

Restores [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.35) × AP + (0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]] Health to allied champions. 

Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by [1] second.

Senna sends forth the Black Mist, dealing [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy hit. After a [1 / 1 / 1 / 1 / 1] second delay the target and other nearby enemies are Rooted for [1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 / 2.25] second(s).
